resources.string: Detects clicks on movie/show recommendation cards in the Android TV launcher and opens the matching page directly in Nuvio or Stremio.
Click a recommendation in the launcher and open it straight in your favorite app
Enter the email you paid with and tap Verify
That email doesn\'t have an active subscription
That email is already in use on another device. You can move it here in %1$d days
This device already used its free trial with a different email. You\'ll need an active subscription to use it here
Couldn\'t verify (check your connection) and try again
Scan with your phone and pay using this same email:
2 days, no card needed (once per device)
Couldn\'t open Accessibility settings automatically on this device — open Settings manually and look for TvRecommendationBridge under Accessibility.
This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
Devices linked to your subscription email
Remove \"%1$s\"? If it\'s still in use, it will need to verify the subscription again.
This device was removed. Verify again to keep using it.
Version %1$s is downloaded — tap to install
TvRecommendationBridge is watching the screen (Fire TV mode)
Only needed on Fire TV, where Android\'s standard method doesn\'t work. Requires accepting a one-time screen recording permission.
Fire TV mode active — watching the screen
Screen recording permission denied — Fire TV mode needs it to work
Fire TV mode also needs "Usage access" — find TvRecommendationBridge in this list and enable it, then come back and press the button again
